selection: windSoundParams: original body unchanged except speed renamed power; direct public siteWind.power instead of windsim mapping.
windowWindParams and treeNearness: original function bodies retained.
gustAt: original independent sweep replaced by the exact public SITE_WIND gust phase using shared time and direction.
WIND_SOUND: near/every/ease/body/band/indoor and window gain/hz values retained; original gust and unused window LFO fields omitted.

audio.js: silent public stub replaced only by a small neutral wind graph/controller; whole original audio.js NOT imported. One shared noise source also feeds window branches, no original LFO, reverb or other sfx.
main.js: public-only 0.25-second wind consumer and explicit opt-in help control; no original main block or weather model imported.
tools/windsoundtest.mjs: seven neutral test cases adapted to power and the existing vegetation gust model.
